name: Speedo silicone swim cap
description: The reliable default. Durable, comfortable, gentle on hair, and easy to pull on without the hair-yanking drama of latex.

name: Arena Vortex Elite finger paddle
description: Built tough — durable plastic and reliable tubing that survive seasons of chlorine and daily life crammed in a wet gear bag. The shape encourages a good catch position.

name: FINIS Zoomers Gold short-blade training fins
description: The fin that created the short-blade category and still the one we hand most swimmers first. The stubby blade keeps your kick rate high and your ankles working, it's comfortable enough for long sets, and it lasts for years.

name: FINIS Agility strapless swim paddles
description: The smartest paddle on the market — no strap, just a thumb hole, so it only stays on if you keep constant pressure on the water with a proper catch. Go lazy and it falls off.
